---
title: "Flat Hierarchy"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  project_root: ""
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
  cutoff_level: 11
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  tbls <- c("Sample_Hierarchy")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
hier <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM Sample_Hierarchy")
normalize_hier_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  id_col <- pick_col(c("id", "ID"))
  name_col <- pick_col(c("name", "Name", "_name"))
  parent_col <- pick_col(c("parent", "Parent"))
  level_col <- pick_col(c("level", "Level"))
  tag_col <- pick_col(c("tag", "Tag"))
  if (!is.na(id_col)) df$ID <- df[[id_col]]
  if (!is.na(name_col)) df$Name <- df[[name_col]]
  if (!is.na(parent_col)) df$Parent <- df[[parent_col]]
  if (!is.na(level_col)) df$Level <- df[[level_col]]
  if (!is.na(tag_col)) df$Tag <- df[[tag_col]]
  df
}

hier <- normalize_hier_cols(hier)
hier$Name <- as.character(hier$Name)
hier$Tag <- ifelse(is.null(hier$Tag), "", as.character(hier$Tag))
if (nrow(hier) > 0 && "Name" %in% names(hier)) {
  hier <- hier[!grepl("\\?$", hier$Name), , drop = FALSE]
}
cutoff_level <- params$cutoff_level
if (!is.null(cutoff_level) && !is.na(cutoff_level) && ("Level" %in% names(hier))) {
  hier <- hier[hier$Level <= cutoff_level, , drop = FALSE]
}
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

tag_to_color <- function(tag) {
  tag <- if (is.null(tag)) "" else tag
  tag <- tolower(trimws(tag))
  if (tag == "yellow") return("#f9e27d")
  if (tag == "blue") return("#9db8d8")
  if (tag == "green") return("#b5d6a7")
  if (tag == "red") return("#f4a6a0")
  if (tag == "orange") return("#f7c59d")
  ""
}

build_flat_rows <- function(df, parent_id = NA_integer_, level_col = "Level", max_level = 11, visited = character()) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(list())
  parent_vals <- df$Parent
  match_parent <- if (is.na(parent_id)) {
    is.na(parent_vals)
  } else {
    parent_vals == parent_id
  }
  nodes <- df[match_parent, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(nodes) == 0) return(list())
  nodes <- nodes[order(nodes$Name), , drop = FALSE]

  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(nodes))) {
    row <- nodes[i, ]
    row_id <- as.character(row$ID)
    if (row_id %in% visited) next
    level_val <- if (!is.null(row[[level_col]])) as.integer(row[[level_col]]) else NA_integer_
    if (is.na(level_val)) level_val <- 1L
    if (level_val <= max_level) {
      row_entry <- list()
      for (lvl in seq_len(max_level)) {
        row_entry[[paste0("Level", lvl)]] <- ""
        row_entry[[paste0("Tag", lvl)]] <- ""
      }
      row_entry[[paste0("Level", level_val)]] <- row$Name
      row_entry[[paste0("Tag", level_val)]] <- row$Tag
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row_entry
    }
    child_rows <- build_flat_rows(df, row$ID, level_col, max_level, c(visited, row_id))
    if (length(child_rows) > 0) rows <- c(rows, child_rows)
  }
  rows
}
```

# Hierarchy (Flat)

Lowest level: `r params$cutoff_level`

```{r hierarchy-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(hier) > 0) {
  max_level <- if (!is.null(params$cutoff_level) && !is.na(params$cutoff_level)) {
    as.integer(params$cutoff_level)
  } else {
    11L
  }
  rows <- build_flat_rows(hier, max_level = max_level)
  if (length(rows) == 0) {
    cat("No hierarchy records found.")
  } else {
    flat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rows, as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    tag_cols <- grep("^Tag", names(flat), value = TRUE)
    level_cols <- grep("^Level", names(flat), value = TRUE)
    view <- flat[, level_cols, drop = FALSE]
    for (i in seq_along(level_cols)) {
      tag_col <- tag_cols[[i]]
      view[[i]] <- ifelse(
        nzchar(flat[[level_cols[[i]]]]),
        kableExtra::cell_spec(
          flat[[level_cols[[i]]]],
          background = tag_to_color(flat[[tag_col]])
        ),
        ""
      )
    }
    kbl(view, escape = FALSE, align = "l") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
  }
} else {
  cat("No hierarchy records found.")
}
```
